source: Jacobson et al., Analysis of the Xedni Calculus Attack (2000), section 3.2 Remark 1

finite_field_curve.point_law: all ordered pairs of distinct nonidentity E(F_47) points

rational_lift.coordinate_rule: centered integer representative in [-23,23] for each affine x and y coordinate

auxiliary_condition.condition: coefficients integral at 7, good reduction, rank-two point-incidence matrix modulo 7, and #E(F_7)=4

relation.rational_event: lifted P1+2*lifted P2=O on reconstructed E(Q)

run_cap: complete 1722-pair census; no wall-time performance claim
interpretation: Amended deterministic r=2 varying-curve lift with one auxiliary weak reverse-Mestre prime; it does not include CRT over multiple auxiliary primes or curve optimization
